# Player Dealt Healing

Source: [wiki article 7450](../archive/7450.md); edited 2025-10-19.

<a id="wiki-7450-n1"></a>

- Dealt Healing includes self-healing; Event Player equals Healer, Healee is recipient (same for self-heal). Context includes Event Healing, Event Was Health Pack, Event Ability and incoming Event Direction.
